GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. hooked Wide turn 5 lengths. battled away # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very keenly throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 1100m when racing keenly had to be checked from heels. Was held up rounding the home turn and until after the 300m. Rider dropped his left rein over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got split in Straight 3 lengths. weakened # Every Chance

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost ground at the start after jumping away awkwardly unbalancing the rider. Near the 800m, when racing keenly, was restrained when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. hooked Wide turn 4 lengths. weakened # Ordinary Effort

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat 2-3l off 4 Wide No Cover , 5 Wide turn improving, Straightened Up half clear, headed passing 300m and gave ground to the line # 4-5 Wide trip

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance
Slow Out 4 lengths Settled Down last 10 lengths. last turn 6 lengths. battled away. slow away # forget
